tool_signatures.name: direct_add_audience_target
tool_signatures.description: Add an audience target to an ad group.

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_bid_modifier
tool_signatures.description: Add a bid modifier. Bid modifier values: 0=disable, 50=decrease by 50%, 100=no change, 150=increase by 50%, 1300=maximum.

tool_signatures.description: Create new callout extensions (уточнения). Each callout text max 25 characters. Up to 50 callouts per ad.

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_feed
tool_signatures.description:
Add a feed (YML/CSV) to Yandex Direct.

Supports password-protected feeds via HTTP Basic Auth.
Business types: RETAIL, HOTELS, REALTY, AUTOMOBILES, FLIGHTS, OTHER.
Max 50 feeds per advertiser.

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_keywords
tool_signatures.description: Add keywords to an ad group. Creates new keywords with optional bid settings.

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_negative_keyword_shared_set
tool_signatures.description: Create a new negative keyword shared set. After creating, link it to campaigns. Max 20 sets per account. Max 5000 keywords per set.

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_retargeting_list
tool_signatures.description: Create a new retargeting list. Rules are grouped: OR between groups, AND within each group. Each rule references a Metrika goal ID.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: Rule groups (OR between groups, AND within each group)

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_sitelinks
tool_signatures.description: Create a new sitelink set. Creates a set of sitelinks that can be attached to ads. Each set can contain 1-8 sitelinks.

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_smart_ad_target
tool_signatures.description:
Add a targeting filter to a smart ad group.

Defines which product offers from the feed are used to generate smart banners.
Without conditions, ALL feed items are used.
With conditions, only matching items are shown (max 10 rules per filter).

available_items_only.description: Show only available items (true) or all (false)

operand.description: Feed field name (e.g. price, manufacturer, category_id, url, title)

operator.description: Operator: EQUALS_ANY, CONTAINS_ANY, NOT_CONTAINS_ALL, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, IN_RANGE, EXISTS

conditions.description: Filter conditions. If empty, all feed items are used.

parameters.name: available_items_only
parameters.description: Show only available items (true) or all (false)

parameters.description: Filter conditions. If empty, all feed items are used.

tool_signatures.name: direct_add_vcard
tool_signatures.description: Create a new vCard. VCards display business contact info in ads. Phone format: +7-495-123-45-67

tool_signatures.name: direct_check_all_changes
tool_signatures.description: Check all changes in the account since a timestamp. Returns IDs of modified campaigns, ad groups, and ads. Useful for full account sync.

tool_signatures.name: direct_check_campaign_changes
tool_signatures.description: Check if campaigns have changed since a given timestamp. Useful for incremental sync - only fetch campaigns that changed.

tool_signatures.name: direct_create_adgroup
tool_signatures.description: Create a new ad group in a campaign. Creates an ad group with specified name and targeting regions.

tool_signatures.description: Create a new advertising campaign. Creates TEXT_CAMPAIGN, DYNAMIC_TEXT_CAMPAIGN, SMART_CAMPAIGN, UNIFIED_CAMPAIGN, or CPM_BANNER_CAMPAIGN with specified settings.

tool_signatures.name: direct_create_dynamic_ad
tool_signatures.description: Create a dynamic text ad in a dynamic ad group. Title is auto-generated from feed data. Only text needs to be specified. Used in DYNAMIC_TEXT_CAMPAIGN with feed.

tool_signatures.name: direct_create_image_ad
tool_signatures.description: Create a new image ad (banner) in an ad group. Creates an IMAGE_AD with the given image hash and landing page. Use image hashes from existing ads or upload via web interface.

tool_signatures.name: direct_create_text_ad
tool_signatures.description: Create a new text ad in an ad group. Creates a text ad with title, text, and landing page URL. The ad will be sent for moderation automatically.

tool_signatures.name: direct_create_video_creative
tool_signatures.description:
Create a VIDEO_EXTENSION_CREATIVE from an uploaded video.

The video must have status READY (check with direct_get_advideos).
Returns a CreativeId to attach to ads via direct_update_ad.

tool_signatures.name: direct_get_statistics
tool_signatures.description:
Get campaign statistics report from Yandex Direct. Retrieves performance statistics for campaigns, ads, or keywords.

Report types:
- ACCOUNT_PERFORMANCE_REPORT - Account level stats
- CAMPAIGN_PERFORMANCE_REPORT - Campaign level stats (default)
- AD_PERFORMANCE_REPORT - Ad level stats
- ADGROUP_PERFORMANCE_REPORT - Ad group level stats
- CRITERIA_PERFORMANCE_REPORT - Keyword level stats
- SEARCH_QUERY_PERFORMANCE_REPORT - Search query stats

Common fields: CampaignName, CampaignId, Impressions, Clicks, Cost, Ctr, AvgCpc, ConversionRate, Date

tool_signatures.name: wordstat_dynamics
tool_signatures.description:
Get query frequency dynamics over time from Yandex Wordstat.

Shows how search query popularity changes over a specified time period.
Only the + operator is allowed in the phrase.

phrase.description: Search phrase to analyze (only + operator allowed)

to_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today)

tool_signatures.description: Get regional distribution of search queries from Yandex Wordstat.\n\nShows how query popularity varies across different regions.

tool_signatures.name: wordstat_regions_tree
tool_signatures.description:
Get the full regions tree from Yandex Wordstat.

Returns hierarchical structure of all available regions with their IDs.
Useful for finding region IDs to use in other Wordstat tools.
